siding_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net siding field area from PaintScope. Engine divides SF by rate to calculate hours.

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Deploy tarps over landscape. Includes staking and securing. ~18 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Lay drop cloths and plastic on flat surfaces. Faster than landscape. ~14 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Fixture and Utility Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Bag and tape fixtures, utility panels, hose bibs. ~4 min per fixture. HVAC units take longer (~10 min).

task_production_rates.name: Spray Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Configure airless sprayer, test tips, run lines, stage materials (~45 min). Per elevation.

task_production_rates.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Stage brushes, rollers, trays, and access equipment (~20 min). Per elevation.

task_production_rates.name: Power Wash Siding
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Pressure washer on siding. 2000-2500 PSI. ~7 sec per SF. Repaint states only.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Loose Paint
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Hand scraping failing/peeling paint. HIGHLY variable — 30 SF/hr for heavy peel, 60 SF/hr for light.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Mill Glaze Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 80-120 grit orbital sand. 100% coverage. ~20 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Sand for Adhesion
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Light scuff sand 120-150 grit. ~14 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Back-Prime Rear Faces
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush/roll primer on rear face. Done on ground at sawhorses. ~14 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: End-Seal Cut Edges
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush sealant on cut ends. ~50 sec per cut edge.
task_production_rates.manual_capture_notes: Count of siding cut edges. Not captured by PaintScope — estimator enters count based on siding layout. Typical: 2-4 cuts per board for butt joints, window/door cutouts.

task_production_rates.name: Spot-Prime Knots
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush shellac/oil-based on each knot. ~1.2 min per knot.
task_production_rates.manual_capture_notes: Count of visible knots on siding faces. Not captured by PaintScope — estimator enters count or uses species-based estimate (e.g., pine ~8-12 knots per 100 SF).

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Gaps and Joints
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Apply and tool exterior caulk at siding joints. ~45 sec per LF.

task_production_rates.name: Prep Dust Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Compressed air or brush dust off. ~6 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Spray
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray primer on siding field. Bare wood absorbs — slower than finish spray. ~18 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Backroll sprayed primer. Per spray/backroll coupling rule: backroll rate ≥ spray rate.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Brush/Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush/roll primer. Brush for edges, roller for field. ~36 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray finish coat on primed siding. Base rate for lap_horizontal. ~16 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Backroll sprayed finish. Per coupling rule: backroll rate ≥ spray rate.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush/roll finish coat. Base rate for lap_horizontal. ~36 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Light Sand
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 150-220 grit light scuff between coats. ~12 sec per SF. QT4+ only.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1 spray. Primed surface is consistent.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1 backroll.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1 brush/roll.

QT5.notes: Fix every defect at arm's length

task_production_rates.name: Protection Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove all tarps, plastic, tape, fixture bags. ~9 sec per SF.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Spray Equipment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Full sprayer flush, tip cleaning, hose coiling. ~30 min per session.

task_production_rates.name: Site Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Collect debris, dispose containers, final site walkthrough. ~20 min.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Height Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Access type drives production rate reduction for elevated work. Conceptually same as FAC_HEIGHT for interior.
factor_modifiers.notes: Applied per elevation. Ground tasks (back-prime, end-seal, equipment setup) are not affected.

factor_modifiers.name: Substrate Condition Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Substrate state affects prep task duration.
factor_modifiers.notes: Peeling is worst case — recommend hourly billing for QT4+.

factor_modifiers.name: Siding Profile Complexity Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Board-and-batten has ~20% more effective surface. Shingle has ~50% more due to overlapping edges.

assumptions: Base rates are for lap_horizontal siding at ground access.
Profile and access modifiers stack: effective_rate = base_rate ÷ (profile × access).
Spray/backroll coupling rule: backroll rate ≥ spray rate.
Environmental conditions (wind, dew point, sun, surface temp) are NOT estimation modifiers (RC-003).
risks: Peeling paint prep (SS_EXT_PEELING) has highest rate variability — recommend hourly billing for QT4+.
Shingle siding + brush/roll + ladder = very slow production (~44 SF/hr before substrate modifier).
Back-prime and end-seal rates assume ground-level work.
